investigation_notes: Network security investigation of a monitored LAN. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over Zeek and Suricata logs (IDS alerts, Kerberos, HTTP downloads, TLS certificates, domains and external-destination activity). No root cause, impact or C2 attribution is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Network context: LAN segment range: 10.1.17.0/24 (10.1.17.0 through 10.1.17.255); Domain: bluemoontuesday.com; Active Directory domain controller: 10.1.17.2 - WIN-GSH54QLW48D; AD environment name: BLUEMOONTUESDAY; LAN segment gateway: 10.1.17.1; LAN segment broadcast address: 10.1.17.255.
